raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Securities Operations Analyst – Middle Office | State Street Services Pvt. Ltd. | Mumbai, IndiaFeb 2022 – Mar 2025 Promoted: Associate I → Associate II based on consistent performance and operational excellence.
Reconciliation & Income Processing
Executed daily two-way cash, stock, and custody reconciliations across multiple portfolios; maintained aged breaks through systematic break investigation and root cause analysis.
Managed Principal & Interest (P&I) reconciliation for Asset-Backed Securities (ABS) and Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), ensuring accurate cash flow tracking and allocation.
Processed dividend and coupon income events using Bloomberg Terminal, DTCC, IDS, and MDS platforms, validating payment calculations and ensuring timely client crediting.
Monitored TRR and WTX on multi-currency portfolios; applied accurate accounting adjustments for foreign exchange movements.
Managed trade settlements for global equities and fixed income securities; identified and resolved settlement failures to minimize client exposure and avoid penalties.
Coordinated claims management for missed income entitlements, working with custodians to ensure timely resolution of dividend and coupon claims.
Maintained security and operational static data with a strong focus on accuracy, control, and data integrity. • Ensured accurate income booking and raised market claims for missed entitlements across dividend and coupon income events.
Control, Reporting & Stakeholder Coordination
Prepared daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports and exception reports for senior management and audit reviews, providing visibility into operational metrics and break statuses.
Partnered with cross-functional teams across EMEA and US Operations under rotational shift schedules to resolve breaks and improve process efficiency.
Ensured strict adherence to internal controls, SLA frameworks, and operational risk policies in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.
Coordinated with internal teams, and external counterparties to resolve operational issues and prevent recurrence.
Products Covered Equities (Global) | Fixed Income (Corporate Bonds, Government Securities) | Asset-Backed Securities (ABS) | Mortgage- Backed Securities (MBS)
Systems & Platforms Bloomberg Terminal | TLM | CAM / OSA | DTCC | IDS | MDS | PLM | TRR | WTX
